description: What to build, with what odds, and whether it is too late: ranks every ranked niche (Roblox and Fortnite) for a team size and a build horizon. Each niche gets its stage, window, heat, a timing verdict (open, steady, tight, late) and a feasibility level (workable, stretch, hard, or null) with the barriers behind it (top game share, big studios or Epic / branded islands among the top 5, update cadence, server size: real exported values, each with its threshold) and a one-sentence reason. Both are documented heuristics, not scores or forecasts. Then call get_gap_analysis on a key. Every game carries asOf (export time, UTC), source and grade (grade = completeness of the game record (A = 8+ of 10 data points known, B = 6-7, C = 4-5, D = fewer); estimate grade: B = tighter range, C = wide range, D = very rough order of magnitude.) Revenue figures are estimates with a range and a grade, never measured sales and never a guarantee. Definitions: resource wieldr://methodology.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous call, to get the next page. Omit for the first page.

horizonWeeks.description: Weeks until you can ship (default 8). Only changes the verdict for closing windows and crowded niches.

limit.description: How many results per page (default 10, max 30).

platform.description: roblox or fortnite (ranked niches exist on these two). Omit for both.

teamSize.description: solo (1 person), small (2-5) or studio. Default solo.

name: find_opportunities

dataset.description: full radar (Pro or Studio key) or free preview (no key).

method.description: One useful sentence; full definitions in the MCP resource wieldr://methodology.

nextCursor.description: Pass it back as cursor for the next page; null = last page.

level.description: Heuristic level for the team size; null = fewer than 2 barriers known.

reason.description: One sentence: stage and window, timing, feasibility and the barriers met or unknown.

verdict.description: Stage and window against the build horizon; null = stage unknown. Never an estimate of how long a window stays open.

previewNote.description: Free preview only: what is missing, with real counts, and where to get the full radar.

title: Find opportunities
